copy.name: aicharts
copy.promise: See which AI model wins at each price.
open: Every AI lab says its model is best.
Few tell you what a task costs.

steps.heading: Score and cost, one chart
steps.body: {{intelligenceConfigs}} model settings by score and cost per task. The line joins the models nothing cheaper beats.

steps.heading: Coding agents as you run them
steps.body: {{codingConfigs}} setups: a model, the agent app and an effort. Hover one for cost, time and tokens.

steps.heading: Benchmarks, each on its own scale
steps.body: {{libraryEntries}} benchmarks cover reasoning, coding, research, memory and media. Charted results stay separate from source guides.

steps.heading: Follow each result to its source
steps.body: The data page names the source, version, comparison rules and limits for every benchmark.

proof.caption: From the checked snapshots each chart plots.

items.label: model settings on the score and cost chart

limits.heading: What it does not do
limits.body: It does not rerun benchmarks. It plots the published results, and every point names its source and date.

end.line: Free benchmark charts. No account or install required.
